overview:
**Fire danger is High today, driven by very dry fuels (88% ERC) and low humidity (13%) that push the Burning Index over its local threshold.**
- Watchout status: 2 of 7 local thresholds met (Burning Index and minimum humidity both exceeded today).
- Week ahead: danger climbs to Very High Thursday–Saturday and again Sunday–Monday, easing briefly to High on Sept. 13 as light rain returns late week.
- Weather driver: sunny, breezy afternoons with gusts near 30 mph today and Thursday; no Red Flag Warning currently posted for this area.
- Restrictions: Stage 1 fire restrictions remain active in Montrose, Delta, Ouray, and Gunnison counties; Stage 1 fire restrictions in effect on all BLM‑administered public lands within Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, Saguache, and San Juan counties. GMUG National Forest lands are currently unrestricted.
- Nearby incident: the Elk Fire 7 miles NW of Lake City (Hinsdale/Gunnison) is 7,257 acres and 73% contained, with no new activity reported.
